parameter_order: HH dB ascending, HV dB ascending, min_looks 0 then 2, patch size 1 then 4 then 9

software.looks_rule: finite and strictly greater than zero, and greater than or equal to min_looks

outputs.description: Count of parameter sets in which the pixel is valid. Not a water extent.
Count of parameter sets in which the pixel is a raw candidate before patch filtering.
Count of parameter sets in which the pixel remains a candidate after four-connected patch filtering.
Raw-candidate stability. Code 2 is fully sweep-stable.
Filtered-candidate stability. Code 2 is fully sweep-stable.

validity.0: valid in some but not all parameter sets

stability.2: fully sweep-stable: valid in every set and a candidate in every set
stability.1: candidate in every set in which valid, but not valid in every set
stability.0: parameter-sensitive: candidate in some but not all valid sets

limitations: Outputs are algorithmic candidates, not confirmed water.
No lake area, shoreline, or polygon was calculated.
The two dates were not compared.
Smooth wet soil can pass the screen.
Radar shadow and layover can pass the screen.
Wind-roughened water can fail the screen.
Vegetation and debris can obscure water.
Filename code N and orbitType MOE remain unresolved.
The sensitivity sweep is not a confidence score.
numberOfLooks is not a confidence or accuracy score.
Two dates cannot separate moisture change from shoreline movement.
